The final database transaction is acquired before object publication; write and finalize failures roll back and remove the exact digest-matching object and reservation; uncertain commits perform receipt lookup before cleanup; expired reservations use bounded claim/delete/acknowledge reconciliation at repository startup and before uploads. Exact retries return the stored receipt and verify or restore the content-addressed object; changed command payloads and tampered objects are refused; mutation and metadata responses omit bytes and storage identity; retained process output contains no uploaded source content.
